title.narrative: Enhancing Civil Society Capacities to Shape Policies and Hold Power to Account (ECHO Grant)

description.narrative: The ECHO Grant aims to maximise the effectiveness, efficiency, and sustainability of the Transparency International Secretariat (TI-S), the global civil society umbrella organisation of TI, and more broadly its members – TI National Chapters – to lead and contribute to policy making in the global fight against corruption and the promotion of transparency, accountability and integrity at the national, regional, and global level.Objective 1: Strengthen the capacities of CSO umbrella organisations for coordinated actions at global and regional levelsObjective 2: Reinforce the capacities of CSO umbrella organisations to effectively represent and be more accountable to their constituencies at global, regional and/or national levels Objective 3: Reinforce the capacities of the members of the umbrella organisations to be actors of good governance in their own right.Value of the contract is 5,555,555 Euros.

recipient-country.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany. The countries involved are spread globally.
